common.host: ws-1 (2x NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090), DISPLAY=:50, Xorg headless, no WM
common.grab_resolution: 1920x1080 (engine window upscale; ffmpeg x11grab of :50, lossless PNG)
common.tick_range: none - poses are setpos/setang teleports, frames pair by index
common.prelude: sv_cheats 1; cl_drawhud 0; r_drawviewmodel 0; cl_draw_only_deathnotices 1; hidehud 15; sv_showbullethits 0; bot_kick; bot_quota 0; mp_autoteambalance 0; mp_limitteams 0; god; sv_godmode 1; mp_ignore_round_win_conditions 1; mp_freezetime 0; mp_roundtime 60; mp_roundtime_defuse 60; mp_warmup_end; sv_infinite_ammo 1; noclip
common.pose_gate: accept a frame only when mean|d| vs previous pose > 1.0 AND two consecutive polls agree within 0.35
common.note: Collection only. No image metric was run and nothing was compared to our renderer.
